name: DigiParser
summary: Document extraction for manufacturers that turns customer purchase orders and supplier invoices into structured fields and line items, with review before export, email-inbox processing, an API and integrations; priced by pages per month.
best_for: manufacturers and distributors that retype customer purchase orders or supplier invoices and want the fields and line items extracted for review, then sent to Sheets, Xero, an ERP via Zapier or Make, or their own system through the API
skip_if: your volume swings a lot from month to month, you need a refund route after paying, or you process receipts for bookkeeping, where a capture tool built for accountants fits better
honest_knock: Billing is per page, not per document, so multi-page POs and invoices use up the allowance faster than the plan names suggest, and confidence scoring doubles the credits per page. Unused credits expire every month, also on yearly plans, and a charged subscription is not refunded. AI splitting, classification and confidence scores start on Pro at $149 a month billed yearly. The ~99% accuracy, 2,000+ businesses and 5M+ documents on the home page are DigiParser's own figures. We have not used DigiParser ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month billed monthly for 500 pages a month, 5 parsers and 3 team members
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-13 in a live browser on digiparser.com/pricing in both the monthly and the yearly view, with the FAQ opened, and on the home page) Three self-serve plans, priced by pages processed per month, each with a 7-day free trial that needs no card. Starter is $69 a month billed monthly, or $49 a month billed yearly ($588 a year): 500 pages a month, 5 parsers and 3 team members, table and field extraction, email-inbox processing, API access and integrations. Pro is $199 monthly or $149 a month yearly ($1,788): 2,000 pages, 25 parsers, 10 team members, AI splitting of multi-invoice PDFs, document-type rules, classification, per-field confidence scores and custom roles. Scale is $399 monthly or $299 a month yearly ($3,588): 5,000 pages, 100 parsers, 25 team members, extraction modes and your own storage. Enterprise is custom for 10,000+ pages, with SSO, your own AI key, white label and on-premise options. EU and US hosting and a standard DPA come with every plan. The FAQ sets the rules: each page uses one credit, confidence scoring costs one more credit per page when enabled, unused credits do not roll over, yearly plans still hand out credits month by month, an upgrade mid-period is charged as a prorated difference, and once a subscription has been charged DigiParser does not issue refunds, though it asks you to contact support with a valid reason.

compare_with.name: Dext
compare_with.why: Dext is in our dossiers too, re-verified on 10 October 2026: from $25.21 a month billed annually for 250 documents and 5 users ($31.50 billed monthly), excluding tax, with line-item extraction an add-on. DigiParser, read on 13 October 2026, starts at $49 a month billed yearly for 500 pages and 3 team members, with line items included. They aim at different desks: Dext captures receipts and bills for bookkeeping into Xero, QuickBooks or Sage and counts documents, while DigiParser turns POs and invoices into data for operations and counts pages.
